technical-summary: rad0036 adds --prefill-governor SPEC (serving v2 prefill_governor): kind=arrival|cap|budget with order=remaining, age_ms, max_seqs, long_tokens, factor; policy in core/sched/prefill_governor.h, four scheduler hooks. Supersedes rad0034/rad0035 and their four serving fields (97 -> 94 options). Age now applies only to prompts waiting to start (rad0035 aged running prefills, which pushed mid-size requests 43-160 s behind long prompts on the card). -long configs set kind=cap;max_seqs=2;long_tokens=16384;order=remaining;age_ms=120000.
user-summary-candidate: Radiance prefill scheduling is now one swappable governor setting (cap or token budget, with remaining-work order and a waiting-age limit); the -long configs start 4k-16k requests within seconds beside long prompts.
